calculation.description: Measures the adverse open-to-close candle body relative to its daily range, scaled by the square root of range-to-price. Higher values indicate stronger intraday weakness and predict higher next-day close-to-close returns. Zero-range observations are invalid.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2020-2022 (IC 0.07116), 2023-2024 (0.06289), and 2025-2026 through cutoff (0.05892). Small cross-asset universe implies conservative IC uncertainty interpretation.
validation.provenance: Exact date-aligned OHLCV artifacts for all 15 tradable benchmark instruments; forward close-to-close returns never use data after the cutoff for factor inputs. Correlation is pooled signal-artifact correlation against CLV, short-term reversal, and momentum references; deterministic library audit remains authoritative.
